paths.name: @comma/ui
paths.message: Import from the component module, such as @comma/ui/components/tag. The @comma/ui barrel loads the whole UI library.

paths.name: effect
paths.message: Effect is used only inside the client core (packages/core). A UI subscribes to the core's topics and makes its calls (@comma/core-client).
